subject: AWS listing: landing page copy + legal metadata checklist
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-28T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Draft landing copy + legal metadata for Acme Health AWS listing

Team — attaching the first pass of the landing page copy we will submit to AWS Marketplace for the Acme Health deal. Also attaching an asset pack with screenshots, logos, and the structured metadata I pulled together for onboarding.

Ask: please review for the following before I send to Jason at AWS tomorrow: 
- Copy tone: should lean technical/product-led but approachable for procurement reviewers (short bullets + 30s elevator blurb).
- SKU/pricing table: confirm the tier labels and example list prices in pricing_tiers_table.csv.
- Legal metadata: check the data residency and data processing descriptions; Acme requires EU data controls listed clearly even though this is a US listing.
- Co-sell blurb: short paragraph for the marketplace listing describing invite to co-sell and how customers contact Acme for implementation.

Quick notes included inline in the doc. If you can get comments back by EOD tomorrow I will consolidate and loop in Jason (AWS) and Sally (Acme).

Attachments: v1_redwood_aws_landing_copy.docx (draft), mp_asset_pack_v2.zip (images & icons), pricing_tiers_table.csv

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partners, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-29T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft landing copy + legal metadata for Acme Health AWS listing

Vanessa — thanks for pulling this together. Quick pass below (high level) and I added inline comments in the doc: 

1) Elevator blurb: tighten to one sentence + a 20-word extension. Remove marketingy adjectives like "revolutionary." Example suggestion: "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM inference for healthcare teams, enabling secure, HIPAA-conscious patient insights."

2) Pricing table: change the tier names to Standard / Enterprise / Dedicated and include per-seat vs per-token callouts. The CSV has sample MSRP; suggest we change the mid-tier price by +10% to align with discounting cadence.

3) Legal metadata: for Acme we must explicitly state that PHI is treated under customer-controlled KMS and that audit logs can be retained for 90 days by default with enterprise retention options. Add a single line: "Customers may opt into log export to their S3 for audit purposes."

4) Co-sell blurb: add contact routing: "For co-sell enablement and case handoff, please contact partners@acmehealth.com with the AWS Account ID in the subject."

5) Assets: include a single 16:9 screenshot showing the Console > Model selection page and one architecture diagram labeled "Redwood Deployment Options." The asset pack looked good otherwise.

I can spin a tightened copy and push back by EOD Monday. Also recommend we ask Jason for the AWS listing category (ISV SaaS / AMI / SaaS) to ensure we select correct fields.

—Marcus
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jason Kim <jason.kim@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marketplace Onboarding <mp-onboard@amazon.com>, Sally Adams <sally.adams@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-30T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Draft landing copy + legal metadata for Acme Health AWS listing

Thanks for the draft — appreciate the thoroughness. A few items from the Marketplace side: 

- Category: This will be a SaaS listing (ISV SaaS). Please ensure the pricing model selected in the submission matches SaaS billing (metering via product codes). If you plan to use per-token metering we need the metering spec up front.
- Required legal fields: we need a short "Data Processing" description (one paragraph), an "Encryption" field (one line), and an explicit statement about whether Redwood or Acme will be the data controller/processor. For co-sell listings, AWS prefers the ISV (Redwood) to be the primary technical contact and the reseller (Acme) to be listed in the co-sell paragraph.
- Logos: PNG with transparent background, <= 500KB and 300x300 recommended. The asset pack had a high-res but also include a 300x300 variant.
- Marketplace imagery: one 16:9 hero, plus three 16:9 screenshots. The screenshots must not include AWS console chrome or personal data.
- Security questionnaire: please return the SOC2 and encrypted-backup checkbox. If you already have a public SOC2 report, paste the public link in the submission.

Can you reply with: (1) final landing copy (plain text), (2) explicit data processing paragraph, (3) image set (300x300 logo + 16:9 hero + three screenshots), and (4) confirmation on pricing metering approach? If you send these by Friday we can queue the listing for the next intake.

Jason Kim
Partner Onboarding, AWS Marketplace
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jason Kim <jason.kim@amazon.com>, Marketplace Onboarding <mp-onboard@amazon.com>, Sally Adams <sally.adams@acmehealth.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-01T16:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft landing copy + legal metadata for Acme Health AWS listing

Jason / team — thanks for the checklist, very helpful. Attaching updated assets and the tightened plain-text copy below for quick ingestion into the AWS intake form. Also included: a one-paragraph data processing statement and an encryption line that aligns with Acme's request. Pricing confirmation: we will use SaaS metering with per-token metering via a product code; sample spec attached (pricing_tiers_table.csv).

Plain text landing copy (for intake form):
Redwood Inference for Acme Health
Deliver predictable, low-latency LLM inference tailored for healthcare workloads. Our hosted and private deployment options let Acme accelerate clinical NLP tasks while keeping PHI under customer-controlled encryption.

Key benefits:
- Low-latency inference tuned for clinical throughput and compliance
- Easy integration: REST API, SDKs, and native AWS routing options
- Enterprise controls: KMS key options, audit log exports, and configurable retention

One-paragraph data processing statement:
Redwood processes customer data to provide inference services on behalf of its customers. For the Acme Health listing, customer data (including PHI) is isolated per-customer, encrypted with customer-managed keys where requested, and not used for model training. Audit logs may be exported to customer-owned S3 buckets upon request to support compliance reviews.

Encryption line (single sentence):
Data in transit is TLS 1.2+, and customers may enable customer-managed KMS for encryption of data at rest.

Assets included: 300x300 logo (logo_300.png), hero_16x9.png, screenshot_1.png, screenshot_2.png, screenshot_3.png; full hi-res assets in mp_asset_pack_v2.zip. Public SOC2 link: https://redwood.ai/security/soc2-report-2026.pdf

Next steps: Jason — can you confirm whether the marketplace intake can accept the per-token metering spec in CSV form, or if we need a JSON metering definition? Also is there a preferred field for the co-sell paragraph so Acme appears in the marketplace co-sell catalog?

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partners, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
